description: Evolving Cityscape: A Dataset for Building Footprints and Heights from Satellite Imagery in China is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Sebastiano Papini et al. The study of cities faces a core challenge: the absence of data that are simultaneously high-resolution, large-scale, and longitudinal. Only combining these three aspects reveals detailed (almost building-level) changes while covering vast urban areas consistently over time and promises advancing our understanding of the driving mechanisms of spatial agglomeration. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2025. Formats: GeoTIFF, Image, Raster. The data are held in Harvard Dataverse and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 20230985. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
